summary: Comprehensive backend + frontend testing of Apex Flow demo trading terminal. All 24 pytest backend tests passed (auth, market data, candles across all TFs, AI Claude Sonnet 4.6 analysis, bot CRUD/toggle/stop, positions list/close, backtest). Full Playwright UI flow passed: login page loads, demo login redirects to dashboard, all 8 key panels render (watchlist/chart/AI/bot/backtest/positions/header/logout), watchlist symbol switch works, TF switch works, overlay toggle works, bot toggle & emergency stop work, backtest runs and displays winrate + equity curve, real Claude AI analysis renders bias badge with narrative/setup within ~5-10s, position close works and moves to history, history tab works, wrong credentials produce error. Only very minor issue: logout redirect navigation slightly slow to detect (button click succeeded but wait_for_url('/login') exceeded 8s occasionally).

issues: Balance badge and ticker on header can slightly overlap with toast notifications at top-right on 1920px (cosmetic only).

critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 559 lines (approaching the 700-line threshold) — consider splitting into auth.py, market.py, ai.py, bot.py, positions.py, backtest.py routers before further growth.
CORS is allow_origins=['*'] with allow_credentials=False — fine since auth uses Bearer tokens in localStorage rather than cookies (frontend never sends credentials). Consistent.
Password min_length=6 is weak for a demo but acceptable; consider bumping to 8+ if this ever becomes non-demo.
ensure_user_state re-seeds a static list of positions per user; idempotent because it checks count==0 first — good.
AI endpoint has a graceful fallback if Claude/emergentintegrations fails — good resilience pattern.
seed_data_creation: Backend auto-seeds demo user + 3 active positions + ~24 historical closed positions on startup via ensure_user_state.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All flows working end-to-end including real Claude Sonnet 4.6 AI call. Backend tests in /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py are stable regression suite. Frontend uses Bearer token in localStorage['apex_token']. AI call typically completes in 5-15s. No blocking issues found.
